Chapter 6423: Not Worthy

Chapter 6423: Not Worthy

Regular disciples from Imperial League couldn’t believe it. This war between “immortals” and “gods” was beyond their reach. Getting close meant being trampled like ants.

They could only rely on Ocean-gaze’s group for protection. Earlier, they believed only Heavenly Crane was left. The situation looked optimistic then; everyone together might be able to hold him back.

Now, the dead combatants have returned to life.

“Not revived, they weren’t completely dead.” An expert from an imperial sect shook his head.

Luosha and Goldblade’s ambush earlier didn’t thoroughly kill the villains. They simply didn’t have enough time to kill the true fate.

Nevertheless, those injuries required thousands of years of recuperation. Heavenly Crane’s healing was essential and looked like a revival.

Luosha and Goldblade understood the extent of the damage inflicted since they dealt it. They didn’t fathom Heavenly Crane’s healing ability.

Although Heavenly Crane hasn’t appeared for eras, he was still in charge of the villains due to his power and abilities.

“Take care of your prey and feast today.” Heavenly Crane spoke, instilling chills straight to the heart.

None saw him but they were intimidated all the same, feeling like fish on a chopping board.

“I’ll fill my stomach today.” Nine-cries laughed.

The others landed in the center of Imperial League.

“Go.” Ocean-gaze endured his pain and conjured a water barrier with rippling waves to stop them.

Imperial League seemed to be shrinking and stored in his newly-created world. Alas, he vomited blood after casting the spell.

Virtuoso and the others immediately poured their power and vitality into him. Goldblade and Luosha did the same.

“Bam!” Nine-cries and Ghost-sparrow tried to break through to no avail.

“Trashes, move!” Heavenly Crane shouted.

They were annoyed but grumbled and moved to the side.

“Crane Claw!” He grasped the myriad dao and clawed the ocean with infused lightning.

However, the moment he cut through the water, it immediately reformed again. It was the embodiment of everyone’s power so it could stop him momentarily.

“Not bad, but won’t last long.” He said.

“Buzz.” Immortal-seek Peak rose into the air; all of its flames gathered into a single point.

This formed an immeasurable abyss sucking in all powers and energies around it.

“Bam!” It smashed against the ocean, instantly crushing it.

Ocean-gaze and the others were sent flying while vomiting blood.

Imperial League became exposed again. Nine-cries and the others salivated, preparing to feast.

“Hehehe, it’s time.” Ravenous Wolf God said.

“Ocean-gaze Ancestor’s corpse is mine, I’ll dry it out first.” Nine-cries said.

Immortal-seek Peak hovered above them and Heavenly Crane spoke: “I will enjoy the three female emperors, you all have the rest.”

Luosha, Thousand-eyed, and Phantom became startled, imagining their fate if they were to fall captive.

“You? Impotent fellas always brag about how capable they are. Otherwise, they will use force to cover up their shortcomings.” Someone interrupted him.

“Who?!” Heavenly Crane roared thunderously.

“Your killer.” The person said.

They looked over and saw an ordinary youth drinking tea served by Alch-deer Emperor. For some reason, there was a pot in front of him.

“Desolate Frontier’s supreme ancestor!” Nine-cries recognized him.

“State your name.” Heavenly Crane became serious since he feared Desolate Frontier.

After all, only a few could be classified as supreme ancestors there.

“Fix your impotence first before prancing around with questions.” Li Qiye sipped his tea.
